title: Byte Engine lightmap asset
description: A standalone lightmap asset: the indirect diffuse light of a level's meshes, path traced on the GPU into one image.

$schema.description: The local JSON Schema reference for this asset.

level.description: The ID of the .level asset whose meshes and lights the lightmap holds.

environment.description: The ID of an environment map whose sky lights the paths that leave the scene. Without it, they bring back no light.

illuminance.description: Lux. Scales the environment to deliver it to an upward-facing surface. Without it, the map's own values are used.

bounces.description: The most surfaces a path hits.

max_extent.description: The image's largest side in texels.
